newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka blue chips dip on selling.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka blue chips dip on selling.

text.p: Prices of Sri Lankan blue chips fell in early Friday trade on selling by retailers, brokers said.

Ceylon Oxygen Ltd fell 4.55 percent or three rupees to 63, Richard Pieris & Co Ltd 3.33 percent or five rupees to 145, National Development Bank Ltd 2.49 percent or six rupees to 235 and Hatton National Bank Ltd 1.89 percent or five rupees to 260.
"Profit-taking has set in as these shares rose rapidly in the rally of the last week," said a broker.
The all share index broke the 750-point barrier on Wednesday, due to good growth expectations in the 1997 and 1998 financial years, brokers said.
